researchQuestion:
Main question: Among older adults living alone in rural Ohio, how does social support relate to loneliness?

Subquestions:
1. Does daily social contact explain this relationship?
hypotheses:
H1 (direct): Higher social support will be associated with higher daily social contact.

H2 (direct): Higher daily social contact will be associated with higher loneliness.

H3 (mediation): Daily social contact will mediate the link from social support to loneliness.
